cite: Ritchie, Sandy (2026). Language Technology Development Index (LTDI), edition 2026-11 (methodology 2.0). https://langtechindex.org

columns.rank: Rank among living languages; languages with the same score share a rank. Empty for extinct languages
columns.tied: How many other languages share this rank
columns.name: English name
columns.speakers: Speakers recorded (LinguaMeta; Wikipedia where it has none)
columns.ltdi: Language Technology Development Index: sqrt(technology x data), each dimension floored
columns.tier: Tier: Very high, High, Medium by score; below Medium, by what's recorded
columns.technology: Technology dimension, 0 to 1, after the floor
columns.data: Data dimension, 0 to 1, after the floor
columns.technology_unfloored: Technology dimension before the floor (used to break ties in the rank)
columns.written_in: For a spoken variety: the standard language its speakers write
columns.through_standard_ltdi: For a spoken variety: the LTDI counting its written standard's resources
columns.through_standard_tier: For a spoken variety: the tier through its written standard
